standard_prerequisites.name: Two-out-of-three for perfect objects: in a distinguished triangle, if two terms are perfect then so is the third
standard_prerequisites.use: Closes the induction step by passing from the truncated complex and the last cohomology module to the full complex.

core_obligations: Induct on the number of nonzero cohomology modules of the bounded complex K (proof lines 18994-18995). The canonical truncation triangle puts K into a distinguished triangle whose other two terms are the truncated complex (shorter, perfect by induction) and the top cohomology module (perfect by hypothesis) (proof lines 18994-18996). By the two-out-of-three lemma for perfect objects, K itself is perfect (proof lines 18994-18996).
proof_roadmap: Set up the induction on the length of the finite complex (proof lines 18994-18995).
Cut with a canonical truncation triangle and apply the two-out-of-three lemma (proof lines 18994-18996).
